title: Policy-governed source escrow under an untrusted change proposal

branchedFrom.note: That line's index is evidence-runs.json at the repository root. It is NOT the index of this line and nothing is appended to it. Its history and its recorded results are not modified here.

note: This index holds runs of the policy-governed line only. A run is indexed ONLY if it measures a pre-registered claim (PREREG.md §19). Docs-only changes, cleanup and operational CI are NOT AN EMPIRICAL RUN and do not appear here. A GitHub Actions workflow number is not a number of knowledge and is not used as one.
countPolicy: runs[] holds indexed empirical runs. The array being empty means no empirical run has been recorded, never that none was attempted.

primaryClaims.claim: A candidate cannot weaken its governing policy.
A candidate cannot replace its governing judge.
A policy-relevant graph change cannot hide behind content equality.
A source policy annotation changes derivation identities but not realised output identities, and causes no rebuild work.

noClaims: Real GitHub hosted-workflow authority is NOT solved by this line. A workflow inside a personal repository is a measurement instrument here, not a gate.
Authenticated durable promotion is NOT solved by this line. No bytes produced by the untrusted candidate phase are promoted into durable storage.

runs.supports: Supporting assertions for §4 (fact visibility) and §5 (direct-attr classification), and the §3.3 wrapper decision. PREREG.md §4.2: fact visibility is a supporting assertion, not a primary claim -- an UNKNOWN fact constrains which selectors the matcher may rely on (§7.3), it does not refute C1-C4.
runs.expectedTrace: Each of owner/repo/rev/tag/githubBase/stripRoot/extension classified DERIVATION_ATTR, URL_FALLBACK or UNKNOWN, on BOTH Nix versions. escrow=true classified into exactly one of DIRECT_ATTR_REJECTED / DIRECT_ATTR_DROPPED / DIRECT_ATTR_SURVIVED, with DROPPED admissible only from a detector qualified by the sentinel on the same run.

nixValueVisibility.note: overrideAttrs preserved every probed public attribute at the Nix-value level on both versions: owner, repo, rev, tag, githubBase, stripRoot, extension, meta, name all present on BOTH the plain and the annotated source.

findings: The seven GitHub facts DO travel through derivation arguments on this pin, and the two Nix versions agree on all of them despite emitting different document schemas (envelope vs flat-map). The claim was measured, not read off the nixpkgs source.

tag is UNKNOWN in the derivation document because this fixture pins by rev and passes no tag. It is present=true at the Nix-VALUE level. That is a real difference between the two surfaces, not a contradiction, and it is why PREREG.md keeps §3.3 and §4 apart.
originHost has no direct attribute and is taken from the URL, recorded URL_FALLBACK. It is the only fact permitted to do so.

escrow = true is REJECTED at evaluation on both versions: nixpkgs' makeOverridable-wrapped fetchFromGitHub refuses the argument. The DROPPED branch was therefore never exercised, and remains an unmeasured outcome of this pin rather than an excluded one.
PREREG.md §3.3 comes back GREEN on both versions, so a wrapper is NOT justified and none is written. Writing one would be machinery invented for a failure nobody observed.
defectsFoundInThisRun: The probe recorded only the FIRST 1200 characters of an eval failure, which on a Nix error is the call-stack ladder and not the diagnosis. DIRECT_ATTR_REJECTED was therefore distinguishable from the other two outcomes while naming nothing about the rejection. Fixed in the next commit: head AND tail are recorded.
